verdict.rationale: Ultrametric is a hosted process service, not an agent itself, so it can serve tools to agents. It documents an official remote MCP server at https://api.ultrametric.ai/mcp with connection steps, auth scopes, and a tools reference (e.g., the `status` tool returning release access and availability), and a probe confirms the MCP docs exist. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of a working MCP connection beyond first-party docs.
